articles.title: Crypto liquidations jump to $1.57 billion as Binance hack sends bitcoin, ether lower
articles.snippet: Bitcoin traded near $77,350 after $6.3 billion Binance hack, with crypto futures liquidations jumping to $1.57 billion.

articles.title: FBI and Secret Service join response to Binance’s $6.3B hack
articles.snippet: US agencies are investigating the theft and helping trace stolen assets, while Binance says about $3 billion has been frozen.

articles.title: Binance hacker’s Bitcoin haul tops Coinbase’s corporate treasury
articles.snippet: The attackers held 18,270 BTC early Friday, topping Coinbase’s reported corporate holdings, and an Ether stash exceeding 500,000 ETH.

articles.title: $8 Million Crypto Kidnapping Lands Texas Brothers 15-Year Prison Terms
articles.snippet: Raymond and Isiah Garcia held a Minnesota family at gunpoint for more than nine hours, forcing the father to transfer over $8 million in crypto, in one of the clearest “wrench attack” prosecutions yet.

articles.title: Binance Hacker Hunts for Exit Ramps as DeFi Exchanges Pause Markets
articles.snippet: Etherscan records show wallets tied to the suspected Binance hack swapping freezable stablecoins for Ethereum on decentralized exchanges.
